rants.title: Get rid of your stupid abstractions.
rants.excerpt: I really don’t understand why people keep doing this. If you need to explain your abstraction layer, it’s already wrong. The kernel is not a university project.

rants.title: No, we don’t do that kind of clever crap.
rants.excerpt: Clever code is bad code. We want simple, readable, and obviously correct code—not something that makes you feel smart for writing it.

rants.title: If you break user space, you *will* hear from me.
rants.excerpt: We do *not* break user space. Ever. Not for 'cleanliness', not for 'design', not for any reason. If your patch breaks user space, it gets reverted—no discussion.
